name: plan-board
description: A pane with a plan selector (project plans, then global), each plan's status and percentage, and the chosen plan's goal and overall progress, read from the planning skill's own progress files.

enabled.title: Plan board
enabled.description: Register the plan-board command and its pane. Off removes both; the rest of the session is unchanged.

plan.title: Plan name
plan.description: The plan to show, by its folder name. Empty shows the plan whose progress file changed most recently.

plansDir.title: Plans folder
plansDir.description: Where the planning skill keeps global plans. Empty uses ~/.config/tsch-ai-skills/plans, or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tsch-ai-skills/plans when that is set.
